SELECT DISTINCT d.chembl_id, d.pref_name, s.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_id AS indication_mesh_id, di.mesh_heading AS indication_mesh_heading, di.efo_id AS indication_efo_id, di.efo_term AS indication_efo_term
FROM molecule_dictionary d
INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON d.molregno = di.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures s ON d.molregno = s.molregno
WHERE di.mesh_heading = 'Cancer' AND d.therapeutic_flag = 1
ORDER BY d.pref_name ASC;
